sn48.7:1.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saddhindriyaṃ nappajānanti saddhindriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti saddhindriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti saddhindriyanirodhagāminipaṭipadam nappajānanti || pa [pe] || Viriyindriyaṃ nappajānanti || pa [pe] || Satindriyam nappajānanti || Samādhindriyaṃ nappajānanti || Paññindriyaṃ nappajānanti paññindriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti || paññindriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti paññindriyanirodhagāminipaṭipadam nappajānanti || na me te bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu ceva samaṇasammatā {brāhmaṇesu} ca brāhmaṇasammatā || na ca panete āyasmantā sāmaññatthaṃ vā brahmaññatthaṃ vā diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti || ||
sn48.7:2.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saddhindriyam pajānanti saddhindriyasamudayam pajānanti saddhindriyanirodham pajānanti saddhindriyanirodhagāminipaṭipadam pajānanti || {Viriyindriyam} pajānanti || pe || Satindriyam pajānanti || samādhindriyam pajānanti || pa [pe] || paññindriyam pajānanti paññindriyasamudayam pajānanti || paññindriyanirodham pajānanti || paññindriyanirodhagāminipatipadam pajānanti || te kho pana me bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu ceva samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu ca brāhmaṇasammatā || te ca panāyasmanto sāmaññatthaṃ ca brahmaññatthaṃ ca diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī ti || ||
